title: AuditEvent
description: Append-only audit-log event scoped by (tenant_id, strategy_id). Every state-changing Activity in the system emits one.

event_id.description: UUID v4 for this event row.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp set by the originator of the event (broker for fills, sidecar for posted, workflow for decided).

kind.description: Event kind tag. Known kinds: SignalReceived, SignalAccepted, SignalRejected, EntryFilled, EntryExpired, ExitRequested, KillSwitchTripped, KillSwitchResetApproved, KillSwitchResetExpired, KillSwitchDegraded, LivePromotionApproved, ReconciliationCompleted, JournalOrphan, BrokerOrphan, OrphanSTC, SymbolDriftDetected, TenantConfigChanged. KillSwitchResetApproved (issue #7) is emitted by a single-operator kill-switch reset — the manual reset_killswitch / reset_account_killswitch (via=manual_reset) or the one-click reset_on_activation (via=live_activation); its subject carries via, cooling_down_until, cooldown_secs, an optional note, and the operator identity keyed per path (approver_id_1 for a manual reset; operator for a live_activation reset). LivePromotionApproved (issue #87) is emitted by the single-operator LivePromotionActivities.activate Activity (the one-click Activate path); its subject includes operator_id, tenant_id, strategy_id, broker_target, activation_mode, approved_at (and expected_account_id when probed). See docs/ops/live-promotion-rollback.md §Sign-off recording for the full SOP. TenantConfigChanged (issue #88) is emitted by TenantConfigChangedEmitter at orchestrator boot when the per-strategy YAML differs from the previously persisted snapshot; its subject MUST include tenant_id, strategy_id, changed_keys (non-empty array of YAML property names that differ), old_values (map of present-key entries from the prior snapshot; redacted-key entries omit the value), new_values (same shape from the new snapshot, same redaction rule), source (string identifying the trigger; "configmap-reload" for the boot-path emitter; future emitters may use other values like "vault-rotation"), and loaded_at (RFC3339 timestamp of the load that produced the diff). The redact-by-key behavior is pinned in this convention: for any key whose value carries a credential or Vault path (as determined by the emitter's redacted-key set), the key still appears in changed_keys but the value is omitted from both old_values and new_values. The redacted-key set is implementation detail of the emitter and intentionally not enumerated here.

subject.description: Free-form structured payload for the event. Schema-by-kind to be formalized as the system grows; v0 uses ad-hoc shape. For kind=KillSwitchResetApproved the subject is constrained by convention to {via, cooling_down_until, cooldown_secs, optional note, and the operator identity keyed per path — approver_id_1 for a manual reset, operator for a live_activation reset}; the JSON Schema keeps additionalProperties=true for forward compatibility. via distinguishes a manual reset (manual_reset) from a one-click activation reset (live_activation). For kind=LivePromotionApproved the subject is constrained by convention to {operator_id, tenant_id, strategy_id, broker_target, activation_mode, approved_at, optional expected_account_id}; it is emitted by the single-operator one-click Activate path. For kind=TenantConfigChanged the subject is constrained by convention to {tenant_id, strategy_id, changed_keys, old_values, new_values, source, loaded_at}; changed_keys is a non-empty array of YAML property names that differ between the prior and current snapshots, and for any redacted key the key appears in changed_keys but its value is omitted from both old_values and new_values (the redacted-key set is implementation detail of the emitter and not enumerated by the schema).

actor.description: Who or what produced this event (e.g., 'workflow:CopytradeSignalWorkflow', 'activity:exec.place_order', 'operator:ridopark').

workflow_id.description: Originating workflow ID, if applicable. Allows correlation across the audit log without joining Temporal history.

correlation_id.description: Optional cross-event correlation key (e.g., a signal_id linking SignalReceived → EntryFilled → ExitRequested).
